rationale: Round 2 produced better benchmarking and clarified that non-closure packages can only partly substitute for closures, but the core conflict remains unresolved: capital and management still insist on credible capacity reduction, while the union and works council maintain hard red lines against closures and compulsory redundancies. Positions are more precisely stated but not substantively converging, so further rounds are likely to circle unless an external intervention reframes the bargaining parameters.
